title: Portable Nucleic Acid Extraction Protocol
author: Anthony J Politza
materials: Wait 00:01:00 for the liquid to spin down.
Wait 00:03:00 for the liquid to spin down.
Discard the QIAamp Mini Spin Column.

Thaw at Room temperature and place on ice: PCR Master Mix PCR primers Water RNA Sample The PCR Mix used in this protocol: Applied Biosystems™ TaqMan™ Fast Virus 1-Step Master Mix for qPCR Applied Biosystems (ThermoFisher Scientific) Catalog #44-444-32 Primers were purchased from Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT).
Gather QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit Qiagen Catalog #52904

steps.title: Label tube and add sample
steps.instruction: Label a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and add the sample (up to 50 µL). If processing more than 50 µL, increase lysis buffer and ethanol proportionally (e.g., 550 µL lysis buffer per 50 µL sample). Do not exceed 750 µL total volume in the mini‑column.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 550 µL lysis buffer to the sample, vortex or pipette to mix, then incubate 10 min at room temperature, producing ~600 µL DNA lysate.

steps.title: Add ethanol to lysate
steps.instruction: Add 550 µL 95 % ethanol to the 600 µL DNA lysate and mix, resulting in 1 150 µL DNA lysate.

steps.title: Load lysate onto spin column
steps.instruction: Place a QIAamp Mini Spin Column in a collection tube. Pipette up to 750 µL of the lysate onto the column top. Turn on the portable centrifuge (rear power switch), verify the front red LED is illuminated, close the lid and press the front button to run the programmed spin (≈60 s). If the lysate volume exceeds 750 µL, repeat loading and spin with the remaining lysate.

substeps.instruction: Close lid and press front button

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to the top of the column, place the column in the centrifuge, close the lid, verify the LED, and press the button to spin (≈60 s).

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2 to the top of the column, place in the centrifuge, close the lid, verify the LED, and press the button to spin (≈60 s).

steps.title: Ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 95 % ethanol to the top of the column, place in the centrifuge, close the lid, verify the LED, and press the button to spin (≈60 s).

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Add 80 µL nuclease‑free water directly onto the center of the column membrane, incubate 1 min at room temperature, then place the column in the centrifuge, close the lid, verify the LED, and press the button to spin. Collect the eluate (~50–60 µL) in the labeled 1.5 mL tube and store or proceed to downstream testing.

substeps.instruction: Add 80 µL nuclease‑free water to membrane center

steps.title: Set up PCR reaction
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine: 6.25 µL 4X PCR Master Mix, 1.50 µL forward primer (10 µM), 1.50 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 10 µL RNA sample, and 5.50 µL nuclease‑free water. Mix well to a total volume of 25 µL.

steps.title: Run thermal cycler program
steps.instruction: Program the thermal cycler with the following steps: Reverse Transcription 55 °C for 5 min (1 cycle); Heat Activation 95 °C for 20 s (1 cycle); Denaturation 95 °C for 3 s (45–60 cycles); Annealing & Extension 60 °C for 30 s (45–60 cycles); Hold at 4 °C. Start the run.
